name: Quake III — fast preview (experimental)
summary: Experimental: compile, a crude visibility pass and fast lighting on one thread. For looking at what you just built.
description:
The quickest Quake III build that still produces something an engine will load: the BSP stage, a crude visibility pass and fast lighting, all on one thread.

One thread is not a performance choice. Measured on Q3Map2 2.5.17n, two eight-thread lighting runs of one map produced two different BSPs and two one-thread runs produced the same one twice, so a preview built this way can be compared byte for byte with the last one. A preview whose output changes when nothing changed cannot answer 'did my edit do anything'.

The light stage is handed three files rather than one: the BSP, the surface file the compile wrote, and the map source. Measured — it exits 1 without either companion, and the file it names in that error is one nobody thought they had asked for.

The crude visibility pass is not what you ship. “Quake III — normal” is.

Quake III support in Auto-Pigeon is work in progress. Shader, patch, entity, compilation and engine workflows may be incomplete.
